product_overview: Meridian Capital Advisory is an institutional real estate advisory platform that presents firm credentials, investment intelligence, track record, and research content for sophisticated investors. The site is designed to build trust through a polished, accessible, and information-rich web experience.
core_goals: Explore the firm’s background and methodology
Review advisory services and investment intelligence
Examine track record charts and transaction evidence
Read published insights and research content
Submit a contact inquiry to the firm
Navigate seamlessly across the site on desktop and mobile

features.name: Site Navigation
features.description: Users move between the main public pages using the desktop navigation or the mobile menu.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click desktop navigation links -> View the selected page
Navigate to / -> Open mobile hamburger menu -> Click mobile navigation links -> View the selected page -> Close mobile menu

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Users submit a message through the public contact form with validation and a success confirmation state.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill first name input field -> Fill last name input field -> Fill email input field -> Fill message textarea -> Submit form -> View success state on valid submission
Navigate to /contact -> Submit form -> View validation errors on empty submission

Navigate to /contact -> Fill first name input field -> Fill last name input field -> Fill email input field -> Fill message textarea -> Submit form with an invalid email format -> View validation errors

features.name: Transaction Filtering
features.description: Users narrow the transaction evidence table by geography and asset class using client-side filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /transactions -> Select Asset Class filter dropdown -> View filtered results in table
Navigate to /transactions -> Select Geography filter dropdown -> View filtered results in table
Navigate to /transactions -> Select Asset Class filter dropdown -> Select Geography filter dropdown -> View filtered results in table

features.name: Track Record Charts
features.description: Users view the firm’s track record visuals and interact with chart details as they appear on scroll.
user_flows: Navigate to /track-record -> Scroll to render charts -> Hover over chart tooltips -> View track record details

features.name: About the Firm
features.description: Users review the firm’s background, methodology, and team information on the About page.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> View firm methodology and team information

features.name: Advisory Services
features.description: Users review the firm’s advisory service offerings and service details.
user_flows: Navigate to /advisory-services -> View service detail cards

features.name: Investment Intelligence
features.description: Users explore investment themes and macro analysis presented on the investment intelligence page.
user_flows: Navigate to /investment-intelligence -> View investment themes and macro analysis

features.name: Insights Library
features.description: Users browse research publications and article listings.

features.name: Home Overview
features.description: Users land on the home page to see the firm’s key statistics and summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View statistics and summaries
